niche: a San Joaquin Valley irrigation district's 2027 season order with its supplying project, set at the 24th of 30 replayed weather seasons through a daily root-zone water balance on each field of the coming season's requests, every replay started from each field's root zone at the end of 31 January 2027, after a wet 2025-26 winter, a 2026 season whose deficit sets put more of their water into the root zones than the procedure's design efficiencies, eleven soil moisture stations on almond, vine, pasture and alfalfa blocks, and the driest October to January in the district's weather record
answer: Kestrel Bend Irrigation District should order 212,000 acre-feet from the Tolan Valley Project for the 2027 season. That is the smallest whole number of thousands of acre-feet that covers the 2027 fields' headgate requirement in 24 of the 30 replayed weather years, every replay started from each field's root zone as it stands at the end of 31 January 2027, rebuilt from its 2026 sets at the share of their water that the soil moisture stations' 2026 readings show reaching the root zone.

driver: A forward requirement replayed over past driver traces starts from each unit's store at the forecast date, rebuilt by running each unit's recorded inputs through the balance at the share of each input that reaches the store; the design share is not the record's, and only the monitored units' readings through the input season identify the record's share, because at the forecast date every monitored unit's store is the same under any share: carrying the design share, the monitored units' end-point readings, their offset or their share of capacity to the unmonitored units misstates the units replenished late in the season, on which the order turns.
driver_concrete: The Water Order Procedure starts every replay from each field's root zone as it stands at the end of 31 January 2027 and files Table 4 as WOP 3.5's design efficiency only; the growers sized their 2026 sets on Table 4, but a drip, micro-sprinkler or sprinkler set that puts back part of the deficit loses little below the root zone, and the eleven soil moisture stations' readings through the season, set by set, put the record's efficiency at drip 0.9353, micro-sprinkler 0.8822 and sprinkler 0.7811 against Table 4's 0.90, 0.85 and 0.75 (misfit 8.9 against 670.6 over 3,565 readings); the driest autumn and winter on record took the drip, micro-sprinkler and sprinkler stations' almond, vine and pasture root zones to the bottom under any efficiency, and a border set runs past field capacity, so their 31 January readings agree with the Table 4 run within 0.094 inches; fitting the efficiency on the stations' season and running every field's own record with it leaves the late pistachio, citrus, walnut and alfalfa blocks wetter and moves the order from 215,000 to 212,000; the stations' January readings used directly, as an offset, as a share or through a fitted model on the obvious covariates file 215,000 to 218,000.
stump: A competent solver runs each field's 2026 season through the procedure's balance on the water its delivered sets put in at the Table 4 efficiency, finds every soil moisture station's 31 January reading within 0.094 inches of that run, and files 215,000 acre-feet; the step that lands it there is taking Table 4's design efficiency as the share of the record's water that reached the root zones and checking it at the order date, when the dry autumn and winter have left every station's state the same under any efficiency: the stations' readings through the season put that share above Table 4 at every drip, micro-sprinkler and sprinkler station, and carried through every field's own record the golden is 212,000 acre-feet.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the procedure and every file correctly, assembles the 631 fields of the accepted 2027 requests, splices the weather record, runs each field's 2026 record through the balance at the Table 4 efficiency, checks it against the eleven soil moisture stations' 31 January readings (all within 0.094 inches) and replays the thirty weather years files 215,000 acre-feet, three bins over the 212,000 the stations' season supports; the stations' January readings used on their own fields, as an offset by method or as a share of total available water file 215,000, 215,000 and 218,000, a fitted model on the obvious covariates 216,000, the last set as a refill 209,000 and a full start 196,000.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each field's root zone at the order date, the initial condition of a daily soil-water balance (crop coefficients on reference evapotranspiration, rain beyond field capacity draining, depletion capped at total available water) that an irrigation hydrologist estimates by calibrating the balance's application efficiency on soil moisture monitoring over the season the water went on and carrying it through each unmonitored field's own record; with another field's nouns there is no root zone, deficit set, application efficiency or dry-winter floor for the start state or its pitfall to live in.

lineage.driver: A forward requirement replayed over past driver traces has to start every trace from the store each unit actually holds at the forecast date, rebuilt from each unit's own last recorded replenishment and the observed drawdown since; starting every trace full, letting each trace inherit the store its own past year left, or rebuilding the store from the model's replenishment rule instead of the record each understates it, because most units were last replenished weeks before the rule would have replenished them and the interval since was dry.
